title: Quick Coords
description: This mod allows the user to send their coords in chat with clicking a keybind that they choose.
body:
**Quick Coords is a lightweight Fabric mod that lets you share or save your coordinates with a single keypress. No typing, no scrolling through the debug screen, no hassle.**




**Features:**
Send Coordinates (default: G) Instantly post your current X, Y, Z position and dimension to chat for everyone on the server to see. Perfect for coordinating with friends on builds, bases, or finds.
Send Coordinates to Self (default: H) Print your coordinates privately, visible only to you. Great for jotting down a quick location without spamming chat.



**Send Nether/Overworld Coords**
(default: J) Standing in the Overworld? Instantly see your equivalent Nether coordinates (and vice versa). No more manual division by 8.
Death Coordinates Automatically shows you exactly where you died, privately, so you never lose track of your stuff again.
Fully Configurable Through Mod Menu, customize every message template, toggle features on/off, rename your dimensions, enable/disable sounds, and more, using simple placeholders like {x}, {y}, {z}, and {dim}.

**Requirements:**

**[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)**

**[Cloth API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)**

**[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)**

Based on the original **[Quick Print Coords](https://modrinth.com/mod/quick-print-coords)** mod by **[jstn9](https://modrinth.com/user/jstn9).**
